name: NEW_MESSAGE
summary:
Sellers or buyers subscribed to this topic will get a notification each time another member or eBay sends them a new message that starts or continues a conversation.

OAuth Scope
In addition to the standard OAuth scope (https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope), this topic requires an access token created using the Authorization Code Grant flow with the following scope:
https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/commerce.message

See Working with OAuth scopes for more information.
shortSummary: Notification when a user receives a new message.

info.title: New Message Notifications
info.description: This contract defines the eBay notification for the NEW_MESSAGE topic. This notification is sent when a user receives a new message from another eBay user or when a user receives a new message from eBay.

MetaData.description: This type specifies the metadata included with the notification.

topic.description: This is the unique identifier of the Notification topic.

schemaVersion.description: This specifies the version number of the topic schema.

deprecated.description: This boolean field indicates whether or not the topic is active or deprecated.

Notification.description: This type includes information about the notification.

notificationId.description: This is the unique identifier of the specific notification.

eventDate.description: This is the timestamp that indicates the date and time (in UTC format) when the event that triggered the notification was sent to the recipient.

publishDate.description: This is the timestamp that indicates the date and time (in UTC format) when the notification was sent to the recipient.

publishAttemptCount.description: This integer value indicates whether this is the first, second, or third attempt to send the notification to the recipient. When a notification is sent successfully the first time, the integer value returned will be 1.

data.description: This container consists of specific information related to the new message data.

NewMessageData.description: This type defines the payload for the NEW_MESSAGE notification.

messageId.description: This string is the unique identifier of the message.

conversationType.description: The enum value in this field indicates if the new message is from another eBay user or from eBay.

enum.description: This value indicates the message is being sent by an eBay member.
This value indicates the message is being sent from eBay.

conversationId.description: This string is the unique identifier of the conversation.

messageBody.description: This string is the body text of the message.

senderUserName.description:
This string represents the eBay username of the sender.

Note: Effective September 26, 2025, select developers will no longer receive username data for U.S. users through this field. Instead, an immutable user ID will be returned in its place. For more information, please refer to Data Handling Compliance.

recipientUserName.description:
This string represents the eBay username of the recipient.

Note: Effective September 26, 2025, select developers will no longer receive username data for U.S. users through this field. Instead, an immutable user ID will be returned in its place. For more information, please refer to Data Handling Compliance.

subject.description: This string is the subject of the message.

readStatus.description: This Boolean Indicates if the message has been read.

createdDate.description: This timestamp indicates when the message was created, in ISO 8601 format.

messageMedia.description: This array is a list of media attachments associated with a message.

items.description: This object contains information about the media attached to the message.

mediaName.description: This string is the name of the media attached to the message.

mediaUrl.description: This string is the URL of the self-hosted media attached to the message.

mediaType.description: This string is the type of media attached to the message. Supported values include: IMAGE, PDF, DOC, TXT. Additional values may be introduced in the future.

X-EBAY-SIGNATURE.description: The ECC message signature. This signature is used to process and validate the message payload.
